enum.statLocationBasis.案件發生地點（鄉鎮市區精度；來源未: Place of occurrence (township/district precision; the source does not say whether this is where the victim was defrauded or where the case was reported)
enum.statLocationBasis.清潔隊清運責任區（區隊與行政區一對: Sanitation team collection zone (one team per district); not necessarily where residents generate the waste
enum.statLocationBasis.門牌所在行政區（月底累計）: District of the street address (cumulative at month end)
enum.statLocationBasis.工廠登記地址所在行政區（月底家數）: District of the factory's registered address (count at month end)
enum.statLocationBasis.建築地點所在行政區（依發照日期）: District of the building site (by permit issue date)
enum.statLocationBasis.死亡者戶籍所在地（依死亡年）: Deceased's registered residence (by year of death)
enum.statLocationBasis.登記或聯絡地址所在行政區（非表演地: District of the registered or contact address (not where they perform)
enum.statLocationBasis.國有非公用土地所在縣市: County where the state land lies
enum.statLocationBasis.國有非公用房地所在縣市: County where the state real estate lies
enum.statLocationBasis.ATM 裝設縣市: County where the ATM is installed
enum.statLocationBasis.金融機構（總機構／分支）所在縣市: County of the institution (head office / branch)
enum.statLocationBasis.ATM 裝設點／分支機構所在鄉鎮市: Township of the ATM site / branch
enum.statLocationBasis.金融及保險業場所單位所在縣市: County of the finance & insurance establishment
enum.statLocationBasis.交易發生地（交易系統記錄之縣市；跨: Where the transaction occurred (county recorded by the system; interbank remittances likely by receiving institution)
enum.statLocationBasis.壽險公司分公司、通訊處所在縣市: County of the life insurer branch or sales office
enum.statLocationBasis.特約商店登記地址所在鄉鎮市區: Township of the merchant's registered address
